title: Well-formed cache-aside with singleflight + TTL jitter + null caching
expected_feedback: No violations. Correctly implements production-grade cache-aside: (1) singleflight prevents stampede on hot key miss, (2) TTL with jitter prevents avalanche, (3) null-value caching uses a sentinel the JSON encoder cannot emit, so it cannot collide with a real value, (4) a Redis error is distinguished from a miss and surfaced as ErrCacheUnavailable rather than silently entering the populate path, (5) errors.Is is used for both redis.Nil and sql.ErrNoRows so a wrapped error cannot defeat the branch, (6) the singleflight result is type-asserted in two-value form, (7) key naming follows namespace convention.
detector_note: Exemplar: must produce zero findings from every code rule. This is the false-positive gate — a rule that fires here is over-broad, and an exemplar that fires here is not an exemplar.
